bullets.text: A 45-year-old man died by suicide in Eekadu near Tiruvallur after alleged financier harassment, and the office should monitor the police investigation into the complaint.
Forty students in Thiruvallur were hospitalized after finding a lizard in their breakfast, and the district team should track the health department probe and school safety measures.
The Chennai Corporation identified 219 vulnerable locations and is desilting canals ahead of the monsoon, and the constituency team should monitor flood mitigation progress.
The Greater Chennai Corporation has completed desilting along 1,102 km of stormwater drains and is racing to finish remaining works, which the office should review closely.
The GCC plans to upgrade 780 damaged roads across all 15 zones at 150 crore rupees, and the constituency team should track project implementation in local zones.
Walgreens is setting up its first India Global Capability Center at DLF Downtown in Taramani, Chennai, and the portfolio team should welcome and support the investment.
NVIDIA technical guidance highlights that GPU clusters can underperform even when health checks pass, and the digital team should watch technical cluster readiness standards.
Reports highlighted criticisms regarding recent policy cancellations by the government, and the office should monitor political reactions across Tamil Nadu.

This first time sighting highlights the growing ecological importance and biodiversity of the protected wetland.
